title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - QoS
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/QoS. Service offering performance values: contractual performance metrics established in Service Level Agreements.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'QoS'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

throughput.description: Relationship. QoS metric for throughput. Links to a Throughput entity.

iops.description: Relationship. QoS metric for Input/Output operations per second. Links to an IOPS entity.

bandWidth.description: Relationship. Contractual bandwidth specifications within SLA terms. Links to a BandWidth entity.

roundTripTime.description: Relationship. Contractual round-trip time defined in the SLA. Links to a RoundTripTime entity.

availability.description: Relationship. Contractual availability of connection defined in the SLA agreement. Links to an Availability entity.

packetLoss.description: Relationship. Contractual packet loss metrics per SLA agreement terms. Links to a PacketLoss entity.

jitter.description: Relationship. Contractual jitter defined in the SLA. Links to a Jitter entity.

latency.description: Relationship. Contractual latency defined in the SLA. Links to a Latency entity.

targetPercentile.description: Relationship. Contractual SLA percentile values for metric guarantees. Links to a TargetPercentile entity.
